claims.claim: ST reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.49B, up 26% Y/Y, with 34.8% gross margin.
Management raised AI-datacenter ambitions above $1B for 2026 and above $2B for 2027; the CFO later said about 80% of the 2027 target is expected from fibre-optic data-link chips.

risks.risk: Near-term AI exposure is concentrated in optical connectivity rather than diversified server-power content.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration and program conversion certainty inside optical-connectivity AI revenue remain unknown.

claims.claim: Reuters reported Q2 EBITDA of $679M versus $797.7M expected and Q3 revenue guidance of $3.70B versus $3.72B consensus, showing a material profit expectations miss despite revenue recovery.

risks.risk: 2027 AI targets depend on engaged programs converting as expected while current profitability remains modest.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong revenue recovery and raised AI ambitions coexist with a material Q2 EBITDA expectations miss.

unknowns.unknown: Margin profile of the AI connectivity mix versus legacy products remains unknown.
